About

Writing is just
research with a pulse.

I'm a Senior Scriptwriter at NB Media. "That's the thing about writing — everyone thinks they can do it. Very few people actually can." I'm one of the ones who can.

Before scripts, I spent three years in content strategy and editorial work — building SEO systems, editing other writers' output, and writing for Myntra, ICICI, Metro, and Mochi. I know how to switch formats, voices, and audiences without losing quality.

I train writers, review drafts, make post-edit changes before videos go live, and have hired too. Not just the person who writes the script — the one who stays until it's actually good.
